titles.name: Dropkick on My Devil!
titles.description: Jashin-chan looks back on the day Hanazono Yurine summoned her. So long as Yurine lives, Jashin-chan can't return to Hell. So Jashin-chan writes Yurine's name in her "Death NOT" and swears that she's finally going to land that dropkick on Yurine. Meanwhile, a former subordinate of Pekola and Poporon, Pino, shows up. Pekola is overjoyed believing God has finally sent someone to bring her home;...

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.description: Jashin-chan hosts a sukiyaki party and everyone's invited, but Pekola the fallen angel has her reservations about attending a "witch's Sabbat" with Yurine, who summoned a devil, and all of their devil friends.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.description: Jashin-chan can't deal with the summer heat in the human realm, so she summons Kori, a little ice devil, to cool her down. Yurine encounters a starving Pekola and treats her to curry, but Pekola is torn between her gratitude and the idea of accepting charity from a witch. Later, Medusa fills Yurine in on her history with Jashin-chan.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.description: Christmas is around the corner, and Pekola is living on bread crusts and milk for another day... until Jashin-chan the evil Santa steals them from her. Later, an unexpected visitor shows up at Yurine's place and introduces herself as Yusa, Kori-chan's older sister.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.description: At the Gachapon Hall in Akihabara, Jashin-chan sinks all her money into the machines in hopes of getting her desired prize, but fails and tries to steal it from a passing child instead. This draws the attention of Tachibana Mei, the supercop of the Banzaibashi Police Department, who takes one look at Jashin-chan... and becomes infatuated.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.description: Yurine buys a take-out lunch for Pekola, but while the angel is once again agonizing over whether she should accept charity from a witch, Jashin-chan eats it. Yurine learns about the history between Jashin-chan and Minos, and Mei the supercop tries to add more things to her prized collection.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.description: Jashin-chan accidentally warps herself into the past while making curry. The ice devil sisters Yusa and Koji return in summer and set up a shaved ice stand, where they very efficiently produce both the ice and the syrup themselves.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.description: On her way home from a shopping run, Jashin-chan is attacked by Poporon, an angel with a chip on her shoulder. Jashin-chan levels up and is rewarded by Satan with a potion that grants her human legs, so she enjoys a day of walking around town and shopping for clothes with Medusa.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.description: Jashin-chan has dumped all of her allowance into the slot machines, so she borrows money from Medusa to buy food... only to lose it at the slots, too. Poporon returns and runs into Pekola, who tries to help her get used to life as a halo-less angel in the human realm.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.description: After losing all her money gambling again, Jashin-chan takes Medusa to the bank to withdraw more money from Medusa's account, and they get caught up in a bank robbery. Jashin-chan is only interested in saving herself, but Medusa uses her gorgon powers to save everyone, becoming an instant hero. The selfish, cowardly Jashin-chan then has the nerve to envy Minos for being more popular than her,...

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.description: Pekola is carrying home the money she made after all her hard work... but she drops it, and it flies directly into a charity donation box. She spends the last of her money on a meal of curry nanban, which Jashin-chan steals and eats. Finally, Pekola finds a new job to make more money, and it turns out to be bodyguard work for Poporon—otherwise known as the holy idol Noel Amatsuka.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.description: Yurine comes down with a cold, and Jashin-chan sees it as an opportunity to kill her at last and get back home to Hell.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.description: Jashin-chan returns to Earth after drifting in space for a while, and the whole gang gets together to spend a couple of days at a private beach... but no one could have foreseen what an epic battle this swimsuit episode would become!

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.description: Yurine faces Jashin-chan's wrath while a devilish dinner debate leads to unexpected choices.

episodes.name: Chapter Chitose
episodes.description: A trip to Hokkaido turns chaotic as Jashin-chan faces angels in a boat race to win back their lodging ticket.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.description: Jashin-chan's revenge quest takes an unexpected turn with pies and new alliances.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.description: Jashin-chan struggles with a trip to the dentist while Yurine offers support.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.description: Jashin-chan's beach day takes a wild turn when a mysterious coffin washes up, revealing a powerful newcomer.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.description: Yurine's obsession with a Tibetan sand fox leads to a bread-eating challenge, but is it all in vain?

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.description: Poporon and Persephone's friendship deepens, but a hidden agenda threatens to shatter their bond.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.description: A baking contest winner shares an apple pie that stirs up a storm of surprises and unexpected turns.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.description: Jashin-chan's friends return from Hell, but she's left feeling lonely and reflective about her past.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.description: Facing her shame, Jashin-chan finds a way to return home, but her friends' reactions leave much to be desired.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.description: Facing an unexpected revelation, Jashin-chan's departure plans go awry, leading to a chaotic snowball fight.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.description: After a costly victory, only Yurine and Jashin-chan remain, grappling with their fate and destiny.

episodes.name: Armageddon Karuta X
episodes.description: Jashin-chan decides to change her character for the beginning of the anime's third season. Seeing her new, serious expression seems to influence Yurine and the other characters, as well... Meanwhile, Pekola welcomes the New Year hungry, as usual. She visits Yurine's house after receiving an invitation to eat ozoni, but for some reason, the gang breaks into a karuta game before they start the meal. The game then progresses into a battle between devils, angels, and humans...

episodes.name: All the Pills Are Hard Candies
episodes.description: Now that Pino has been run out of Heaven, she fears that someone will be coming from there at any time to eliminate her. She heads to the park, where she hears Yurine's angry voice. Startled, Pino looks over to see Yurine's fist flying toward Jashin-chan... but striking a little girl instead. Yurine panics when she realizes what she's done, but the child seems unfazed. Pino then realizes that the child is Lierre, the God of Heaven, on a visit to the human realm.

episodes.name: The Deadly Party Whistle
episodes.description: The many sides of Jashin-chan are holding a meeting within Jashin-chan's head. It seems one of the attendees believes that Jashin-chan is incapable of ever beating Yurine, and the "original" is intent on rooting out the traitor, but they all begin to suspect each other and an argument ensues. Later, Yurine and Jashin-chan come across a Jizo statue by the roadside, and Jashin-chan eats the mikan that someone left there as an offering. Yurine warns her that she may incur karma's wrath for stealing an offering to a god, but Jashin-chan doesn't listen...

episodes.name: How to Have a Wicked Time in Jinbocho
episodes.description: Jashin-chan is helping Pino for once, by raking up fallen leaves. Once she has swept them into a sizable pile, she smiles suspiciously as she looks at them, seeming to formulate a plan... Days later, Jashin-chan is walking down the street, visibly frustrated, when a great idea hits her! She hides in Yurine's room disguised as a statue while Yurine is away from home. But when Yurine returns home and actually doesn't seem to notice the statue's true identity, Jashin-chan is so surprised that she loses sight of her plan...

episodes.name: To Love and Be Loved by Thirty Million
episodes.description: Jashin-chan is excited to learn that her beloved childhood teacher, Persephone, is coming to visit.

episodes.name: Gilding Kamuy: Kushiro
episodes.description: When Jashin-chan runs away to escape debt collectors, the gang heads to Kushiro, Hokkaido, to find her.

episodes.name: The Shape of a Smile: What I Found in Obihiro
episodes.description: Jashin-chan's flight from debt collectors takes her to Obihiro, Hokkaido, where she continues trying to make a quick fortune.

episodes.name: Riding a Dolphin Into Chaos
episodes.description: Jashin-chan continues to flee from debt collectors, this time ending up in the southern coastal town of Minamishimabara.

episodes.name: Lavender-Colored Eyes Misting Over in Furano
episodes.description: As the gang explores Furano, Hokkaido, the weight of Jashin-chan's debt begins to push her and Medusa to the brink of despair...

episodes.name: Ask the Sky! My Name Is Jashin-chan!
episodes.description: Jashin-chan comes home to find Yurine gone, and begins to wonder if she's finally abandoned her.

episodes.name: The Jinbocho Blood Donation Center
episodes.description: Jashin-chan recalls all the naughty things she did as a child, and decides to donate blood to make up for them.

episodes.name: Forever Dropkick
episodes.description: Princess Ecute of the vampires tries to get Yurine to join the vampire clan, and Jashin-chan is determined to stop her.
